evidence: Security policy v4.2 reviewed; named CISO
SOC 2 Type II (2026) covers the US-East region only
Primary storage in Toronto; disaster recovery replica in US-East
AES-256 at rest with keys in the cloud provider's KMS
TLS 1.2 minimum enforced; checked with an external TLS scan
MFA required for all support staff
SAML SSO supported; only two built-in roles
Logs kept 90 days; longer retention is an extra cost
Contract says "without undue delay" with no hour limit
Yearly third-party penetration test; critical patches within 14 days
DR tested twice a year; RTO 4 hours and RPO 1 hour
Subprocessor list is public; no advance notice of changes
Export in DICOM format and a deletion certificate within 30 days
Criminal record checks for all staff
